tagline: European inland waterway shipping association representing industry, insurance and survey interests
hero_kpi_rationale: Reflects the extent and reach of the association's influence in the European inland shipping sectors, including industry, insurance, and technical surveying.
company_description: DEUTZ Aktiengesellschaft engages in the development, production, distribution, maintenance, and servicing of diesel and gas engines in Germany, Rest of Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia Pacific, and the United States. It operates through five segments: Services, Engines, NewTech, Energy, and Defense & Other. The company offers engine finder, diesel engines, gas and gasoline engines, and hydrogen engines, as well as electric technology, such as electric systems, high voltage battery systems, and powertree products. It also provides spare parts for large and medium sized engines, such as turbo charger, starter, alternator, piston, piston liner, valves, crankshaft, camshaft, piston rods, water pump, oil pump, oil cooler, injection system, cylinder head, engine control unit, eat technology; operating liquids, oil, coolant, power blue, additives, fuel requirements; maintenance parts, air, oil, fuel filters, cylindrical head gasket, engine gasket set, and v- belt; xchange engines and parts; lifecycle solutions, care programs, diesel particulate filter cleaning services; daimler truck off-highway engines services; and hybrid, all-electric, and hydrogen drives, including mobile rap

kpis.name: Loss Prevention Colloquium Participants

kpis.description: The first IVR Loss Prevention Colloquium held in Antwerp on November 4, 2024, attracted 80 participants including insurers, brokers, surveyors and shipping companies from Belgium, Netherlands and Germany.
kpis.signal: Demonstrates engagement and interest in loss prevention and risk management within the inland shipping sector.

kpis.description: The Loss Prevention Colloquium in Antwerp attracted participants from 3 countries (Belgium, Netherlands, Germany), showing strong regional engagement in loss prevention and technical knowledge sharing.
kpis.signal: Indicates cross-border engagement in loss prevention initiatives.
